Maria Chen: Quick sync — CloudCon satellite session confirmed for Tue 10/12. Need: speaker lineup, demo-kit spec, and swag pickup timeline. 🧭
Aj Patel: Awesome. How many speaker slots do we have and who's the partner booth lead?
Kevin O'Neill: We have 3x 20-min slots + 1x 10-min lightning. Partner lead = Alice (VertexLabs). She can demo model routing and cost dashboard.
Samira R.: Demo kit checklist (early draft): laptop w/ Docker image, 1x 3090 dev box, HDMI splitter, ethernet dongle, 2x power strips, USB mics, HDMI cables, sticker pack. Weight ~ 28kg.
Maria Chen: For swag — planning 250 attendee bundles: sticker sheet, 1x travel mug, 1x partner postcard, 1x Redwood postcard. Need customs-friendly description for international shipping.
Kevin O'Neill: Shipping manifest (copy/paste):

```
SKU,Description,Qty,Dimensions(cm),Weight(kg),Value(USD)
RDW-TS-001,Sticker sheet,300,20x15x1,0.2,3
RDW-MUG-02,Travel mug,250,12x10x10,0.45,8
PTNR-IMG-10,Partner postcard,300,15x10x0.1,0.05,0.5
DEMO-KIT-VM,Demo kit (laptop+accessories),6,50x40x30,28,1200
```

Kevin O'Neill: Suggest using FedEx International Economy for the demo kits (cheaper, handles batteries). Swag can go ground to the venue warehouse.
Logistics Bot: Pickup window available: 10/8 — 10/9 (warehouse #7). Customs paperwork: declare as "Promotional materials and demo electronics". HS codes for mugs and electronics required.
Samira R.: Need power availability at booth? AV asked for a 15A dedicated circuit for the dev box. Also request a 1-hour AV check with venue on 10/11 morning.
Aj Patel: Fallback plan — if live demo fails, we stream a pre-recorded walkthrough (2:30) and then do Q&A from partner. Samira, can you record and stage that?
Samira R.: Yes — I'll record short failover video and upload to shared drive by 10/5.
Maria Chen: Slide deck deadline: 10/6 for final QA. Who owns run-of-show? @Aj Patel take point for run-of-show and timing, Kevin helps with partner handoff.
Aj Patel: Got it — I'll assemble the run-of-show doc and send calendar invites. Can someone confirm swag courier pick-up contact?
Courier-Team: Hi — pickup contact is Priya (ops). We'll coordinate customs paperwork once you send manifest + commercial invoice. ETA for customs clearance depends on country exemptions.
Maria Chen: Action items: Samira uploads failover video by 10/5; Kevin finalizes manifest + courier by 10/1; Aj produces run-of-show + invites by 10/3; Logistics to confirm pickup window by EOD. Please react with :white_check_mark: when done.
Aj Patel: Adding calendar block and run-of-show draft now. :thumbsup:
Kevin O'Neill: I'll DM Alice to confirm AV checklist and bring an HDMI-to-DisplayPort adapter.
Samira R.: I'll also pack 2x spare mics and a Zoom backup license.
Maria Chen: Perfect — thanks team. We'll do a final dry run on 10/11 09:00 venue time.
Logistics Bot: Automated calendar invite created: "CloudCon Satellite — Dry Run" 2025-10-11 09:00.
Maria Chen: Closing thread — please update the manifest if quantities change.
